title: Invertibility of the discrete integral tensor comparison
statement:
Let $l$ be prime, $E/\mathbf Q_l$ finite, and $g:X\to Y$ an isomorphism of arbitrary schemes. Use the concrete root limits, constant integral coefficients and tensor sheaves [def-pur-twist-sheaves], and the canonical root comparison [lem-pur-roots-of-unity-inverse-image-iso]. Let $r:g^{-1}L_Y\to L_X$ be its prescribed inverse-limit comparison and assume it is invertible. Any additive sheaf morphism $\phi:\mathcal O_E(1)_Y\to g_*\mathcal O_E(1)_X$ sending every local pure tensor $b\otimes x$ to $c_B(b)\otimes r(\eta(x))$ is invertible, where $c_B$ is the constant integral direct-image comparison and $\eta$ the adjunction unit. This asserts only invertibility of the specified map, not its construction or completed scalar compatibility.

theorem frobeniusIntegralDiscreteTransport_isIso
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (E : Type u) [Field E]
    [Algebra (Padic l) E] [FiniteDimensional (Padic l) E]
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (g : X ⟶ Y) [IsIso g]
    (r : (proEtaleSheafInverseImage g AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}).obj
      (purTwistZlOne Y l) ⟶ purTwistZlOne X l)
    (hr : r = limit.post (proEtaleRootsOfUnityTower Y l Fact.out)
        (proEtaleSheafInverseImage g AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) ≫
      lim.map (((proEtaleRootsOfUnityInverseImageIso g).2.1 l Fact.out).choose))
    (hrIso : IsIso r)
    (φ : (SheafOfModules.toSheaf _).obj (purTwistIntegralModule Y l E) ⟶
      (proEtaleSheafDirectImage g AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}).obj
        ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf _).obj (purTwistIntegralModule X l E)))
    (hform : ∀ (V : Y.ProEt) (b : (purTwistIntegralConstant Y l E).obj.obj (op V))
        (x : (purTwistZlOne Y l).obj.obj (op V)),
        φ.hom.app (op V) (purTwistIntegralTensor Y l E (op V) b x) =
          purTwistIntegralTensor X l E (op ((proEtaleBaseChange g).obj V))
            ((proEtaleConstantDirectImageMap g CommRingCat.{u + 1}
              (CommRingCat.of (ULift.{u + 1} (Padic.coefficientExtensionIntegers l E)))).hom.app
              (op V) b)
            (r.hom.app (op ((proEtaleBaseChange g).obj V))
              (((proEtaleSheafAdjunction g AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}).unit.app
                (purTwistZlOne Y l)).hom.app (op V) x))) : IsIso φ

proof.text: The constant ring comparisons are isomorphisms: each is the adjunction unit followed by the direct image of the canonical constant inverse-image isomorphism. Similarly the adjunct of r is invertible, because both its unit and r are invertible.

Use root_limit_linear and constant_naturality, the proved arbitrary-scheme sublemmas in AmbRootTowerPullbackCoherence, to make the two tensor factors semilinear over the constant Z_l comparison. TensorProduct.congr makes their tensor map bijective on every object. Restrictions commute on pure tensors by naturality of the two factors, hence everywhere by tensor induction.

The sheafification unit on X is locally bijective; precomposition by the cocontinuous base-change site equivalence preserves local injectivity and surjectivity. The pure-tensor hypothesis proves eta_Y followed by phi equals the raw tensor map followed by this precomposed unit. In the sheafification equivalences W, use two-out-of-three to cancel eta_Y. A map between sheaves in W is an isomorphism.

mathlib_searches.query: A bijective semilinear map on each tensor factor gives an equivalence of tensor products, and sheafification along an equivalence of sites preserves this isomorphism.
